attchmntText: Brainbees Solutions Limited has submitted to the Exchange about outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors of Brainbees Solutions Limited held on November 14, 2026
voiceSummary: Brainbees Solutions Limited, trading as Firstcry, reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the standalone and consolidated results on November 14, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 7,587.54 million Indian Rupees. Profit for the period stood at 391.95 million Indian Rupees. Earnings per share were 0.75 Indian Rupees. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 14,371.83 million Indian Rupees. Profit for the period was 607.83 million Indian Rupees. Earnings per share were 1.16 Indian Rupees. The statutory auditors, Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP, issued a limited review report confirming no material misstatements.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on the utilization of proceeds raised through issuance of equity shares by way of Public Issue of the Company.
voiceSummary: Brainbees Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer. The report, issued by ICRA Limited, confirms no deviation from the objects of the issue. The IPO size was INR 4,193.728 Crore, with net proceeds of INR 1,601.735 Crore. Shareholder approval for proposed changes in the deployment of funds was obtained at the Annual General Meeting held on September 22, 2026. The company utilized INR 64.234 Crore for issue-related expenses. For setting up new modern brands, INR 24.019 Crore was utilized against a revised cost of INR 66.148 Crore. Investment in subsidiary Digital Age saw utilization of INR 177.028 Crore against a revised cost of INR 383.681 Crore. Investment in subsidiary FirstCry Trading for overseas expansion utilized INR 19.925 Crore against a revised cost of INR 23.471 Crore. The remaining funds remain unutilized.

attchmntText: Brainbees Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of additional stake in Dynamic IT Solution Private Limited by Globalbees Brands Private Limited, material subsidiary of the Company
voiceSummary: Brainbees Solutions Limited disclosed that its material subsidiary, Globalbees Brands Private Limited, acquired an additional 10.09% stake in Dynamic IT Solution Private Limited on November 13, 2026. This transaction increased Globalbees' holding in the step-down subsidiary from 89.91% to 100%. The acquisition was made for cash consideration of INR 1.02 Crore. Dynamic IT Solution Private Limited is engaged in the business of fitness equipment and sports products under the brand name Strauss. The entity was incorporated in India on October 31, 2002. The transaction is considered at arm's length. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required.
